records.literal_gloss: A psalm, a song of [the] dedication of the house, of David.

en.L: A psalm. A song for the dedication of the house. Of David.
en.B: A psalm. A song for the dedication of the house. Of David.
en.R: A song for the time when the house was dedicated to God. By David.

fr.L: Un psaume. Un cantique pour la dédicace de la maison. De David.
fr.B: Psaume. Cantique pour la dédicace de la maison. De David.
fr.R: Un chant pour le jour où la maison a été consacrée à Dieu. Par David.

sw.L: Zaburi. Wimbo wa kuweka wakfu nyumba. Ya Daudi.
sw.B: Zaburi. Wimbo wa kuweka wakfu nyumba. Ya Daudi.
sw.R: Wimbo wa wakati nyumba ilipowekwa wakfu kwa Mungu. Ya Daudi.

es.L: Un salmo. Un cántico para la dedicación de la casa. De David.
es.B: Un salmo. Un cántico para la dedicación de la casa. De David.
es.R: Un canto para cuando la casa fue dedicada a Dios. Escrito por David.

vi.L: [Một] thi thiên. [Một] bài ca cho lễ khánh thành ngôi nhà. Của Đa-vít.
vi.B: Thi thiên. Bài ca cho lễ khánh thành ngôi nhà. Của Đa-vít.
vi.R: Bài ca cho dịp ngôi nhà được dâng hiến cho Đức Chúa Trời. Của Đa-vít.

ko.L: 시. 그 집의 봉헌을 위한 노래. 다윗의 [시].
ko.B: 시. 그 집의 봉헌을 위한 노래. 다윗의 시.
ko.R: 그 집을 하나님께 바칠 때 부르는 노래. 다윗이 지은 노래.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the dedication of the house: probably the temple
alternatives: the rededication of the temple in later times
decisions.reason: The word (chanukkah) is the dedication of a building for its use. "The house" may be the temple, for which David prepared (1 Chronicles 22), or David's own palace (2 Samuel 5). In later Jewish practice the psalm was read at Hanukkah, the feast of the rededication of the temple in 164 BC.

decisions.choice: a psalm, a song: two names for the piece
decisions.reason: The title uses both words: mizmor, a song sung to music (3:1), and shir, a song.

decisions.choice: the house ... to God
decisions.reason: Readable says the house was dedicated to God; which house is not settled (m2).

decisions.choice: "un cantique" for shir at Literal and Balanced, "un chant" at Readable, for the whole block
decisions.reason: As the Psalms terms note sets. Readable, like the English Readable, folds "a psalm, a song" into one word.

decisions.choice: un cántico (L, B); un canto (R)
decisions.reason: Shir is "un cántico" at Literal and Balanced and "un canto" at Readable, so that it stays distinct from mizmor ("un salmo") where the English has both.

decisions.choice: "bài ca" for the song (shir) beside "thi thiên" for the psalm (mizmor)
decisions.reason: The terms note gives "bài ca" for shir at every level; Readable keeps only "Bài ca", as the English Readable has only "A song".

source.text: אֲרוֹמִמְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה כִּ֣י דִלִּיתָ֑נִי וְלֹא־שִׂמַּ֖חְתָּ אֹיְבַ֣י לִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: I will exalt you, YHWH, for you have drawn me up and have not let my enemies rejoice over me.

en.L: I will exalt {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have drawn me up and have not let my enemies rejoice over me.
en.B: I will praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} as high above all, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} drew me up as from a well and did not give my enemies the joy of seeing me fall.
en.R: I will praise how great {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} pulled me up out of a deep pit. You did not let my enemies laugh at me.

fr.L: Je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}exalterai, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as tiré d’en bas, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’as pas laissé mes ennemis se réjouir à mon sujet.
fr.B: Je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}élèverai par mes louanges, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as remonté comme on tire l’eau d’un puits et que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’as pas donné à mes ennemis la joie de me voir tomber.
fr.R: Je dirai combien {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es grand, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as tiré d’un trou profond. Tu n’as pas laissé mes ennemis se moquer de moi.

sw.L: Nitakutukuza {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana umenivuta juu, wala hukuwaacha adui zangu wanifurahie.
sw.B: Nitakusifu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} kuwa juu ya yote, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu ulinivuta juu kama kutoka kisimani, wala hukuwapa adui zangu furaha ya kuniona nikianguka.
sw.R: Nitasifu ukuu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu ulinitoa katika shimo refu. Hukuwaacha adui zangu wanicheke.

es.L: Te exalto, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me has sacado y no has dejado que mis enemigos se alegren de mí.
es.B: Te alabaré como el más alto, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me sacaste como de un pozo y no diste a mis enemigos el gusto de verme caer.
es.R: Alabaré lo grande que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me sacaste de un pozo profundo. No dejaste que mis enemigos se rieran de mí.

vi.L: Tôi sẽ tôn cao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã kéo tôi lên và đã không để kẻ thù tôi vui mừng vì tôi.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi sẽ tôn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lên cao trên hết, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã kéo tôi lên như kéo từ dưới giếng, và đã không cho kẻ thù tôi được hả hê thấy tôi gục ngã.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi sẽ ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vĩ đại biết bao, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã kéo tôi lên khỏi hố sâu. Ngài không để kẻ thù cười nhạo tôi.

ko.L: 제가 주님을 높이겠습니다, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여. 주님께서 저를 끌어올리시고, 제 원수들이 저를 두고 기뻐하지 못하게 하셨기 때문입니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 주님을 높이 찬양하겠습니다. 주님께서 우물에서 길어 올리듯 저를 건지시고, 제 원수들이 제가 쓰러지는 것을 보고 기뻐하지 못하게 하셨기 때문입니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 주님께서 얼마나 위대하신지 찬양하겠습니다. 주님께서 깊은 구덩이에서 저를 끌어올려 주셨습니다. 제 원수들이 저를 비웃지 못하게 하셨습니다.

decisions.choice: drawn me up: lifted out, like a bucket from a well
decisions.reason: The verb (dalah) is used of drawing water (Exodus 2:16, 19). The psalmist was pulled up from the depths of death (verse 4).

decisions.choice: exalt: praise as high
decisions.reason: The verb (romem) is to lift high; in praise it means to honor God as supreme.

decisions.choice: as from a well (B); out of a deep pit (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable fill out the picture in the verb (m1).

decisions.choice: The psalm is spoken to God in 합쇼체 with "저"; verses 5-6 turn to the faithful in 해라체 ("찬송하여라") and speak of the LORD with the honorific
alternatives: one speech level for the whole psalm
decisions.reason: Style guide section 7a. Verse 5 calls on God's faithful ones, so it speaks to them, not to God; the prayer to God resumes in verse 7. The prayer quoted in verses 10-11 is 합쇼체 like the rest.

records.literal_gloss: YHWH my God, I cried to you for help, and you healed me.

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, I cried to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for help, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} healed me.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, my God, I shouted to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for help, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made me well.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, I cried out to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to help me, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made me well again.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, j’ai crié vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} au secours, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as guéri.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, mon Dieu, j’ai appelé vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} au secours, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as rétabli.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, j’ai crié vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’aides, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as guéri.

sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wangu, nilikulilia unisaidie, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} ukanipa afya.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, nilikulilia unisaidie, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} ukanirudishia afya yangu.

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío, clamé a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} por ayuda, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me sanaste.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios mío, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} grité pidiendo ayuda, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me devolviste la salud.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios mío, clamé a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} para que me ayudaras, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me sanaste otra vez.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, tôi đã kêu cứu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chữa lành tôi.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, tôi đã kêu lớn xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cứu giúp, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chữa lành tôi.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, tôi đã kêu xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giúp tôi, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho tôi khỏe lại.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 저의 하나님, 제가 주님께 도와 달라고 부르짖었더니, 주님께서 저를 고쳐 주셨습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저의 하나님, 제가 주님께 도와 달라고 소리쳤더니, 주님께서 저를 낫게 하셨습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 저의 하나님, 제가 도와 달라고 주님께 부르짖었더니, 주님께서 저를 다시 건강하게 해 주셨습니다.

decisions.choice: healed: made well
decisions.reason: The verb (rafa') is to heal; the psalm seems to look back on an illness that nearly killed the psalmist (verses 4, 10), though healing can also mean restoring from any disaster.

source.text: יְֽהוָ֗ה הֶֽעֱלִ֣יתָ מִן־שְׁא֣וֹל נַפְשִׁ֑י חִ֝יִּיתַ֗נִי מִיָּֽרְדִי־בֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH, you brought up from Sheol my soul; you kept me alive from my going down [to the] pit.

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} brought up my soul from Sheol; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} kept me alive from going down [to the] pit.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} brought me back up from Sheol; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} kept me alive and did not let me sink into the pit.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I was almost dead, but {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} brought me back from the place of the dead. You kept me alive and did not let me go down into the grave.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait remonter mon âme du Shéol ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as gardé en vie [pour que je ne] descende [pas dans la] fosse.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as fait remonter du séjour des morts ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as gardé en vie et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne m’as pas laissé sombrer dans la fosse.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’étais presque mort, mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as ramené du séjour des morts. Tu m’as gardé en vie, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne m’as pas laissé descendre dans la tombe.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, umeipandisha nafsi yangu kutoka Kuzimu; umenihifadhi hai nisishuke [katika] shimo.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, umenirudisha juu kutoka Kuzimu; umeniweka hai, hukuniacha nizame shimoni.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nilikuwa karibu kufa, lakini ulinirudisha kutoka Kuzimu, mahali pa wafu. Uliniweka hai, hukuniacha nishuke kaburini.

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} hiciste subir mi alma del Seol; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me mantuviste con vida para no bajar a [la] fosa.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me hiciste volver del lugar de los muertos; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me mantuviste con vida y no dejaste que me hundiera en la fosa.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, yo estaba casi muerto, pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me trajiste de vuelta del lugar de los muertos. Me mantuviste con vida y no dejaste que bajara a la tumba.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đem linh hồn tôi lên khỏi Âm Phủ; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giữ tôi sống khỏi việc đi xuống huyệt.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đem tôi lên khỏi Âm Phủ; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giữ tôi sống và không để tôi chìm xuống huyệt sâu.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi gần chết rồi, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đem tôi về từ nơi của người chết. Ngài đã giữ tôi sống và không để tôi đi xuống mồ.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 제 영혼을 스올에서 끌어올리셨고, 제가 구덩이로 내려가지 않도록 저를 살려 두셨습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 저를 스올에서 다시 끌어올리셨고, 저를 살려 두셔서 구덩이로 가라앉지 않게 하셨습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저는 거의 죽을 뻔했지만, 주님께서 죽은 사람들이 있는 곳에서 저를 다시 데려오셨습니다. 주님께서 저를 살려 두시고 무덤으로 내려가지 않게 하셨습니다.

decisions.choice: from going down: the word as read, not as written
alternatives: from among those who go down to the pit (as written)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text writes "from those who go down to the pit" and its notes say to read "from my going down to the pit". The words follow the form to be read; the meaning is nearly the same.

decisions.choice: Sheol: the world of the dead
decisions.reason: As in 6:6; the psalmist was as good as dead when God brought him back.

decisions.choice: the pit: the grave
decisions.reason: As in 28:1.

decisions.choice: me
decisions.reason: The word (nefesh) here is the psalmist's life, himself.

decisions.choice: "le Shéol" at Literal, "le séjour des morts" at Balanced and Readable, for the whole block; "mon âme" (nefesh) at Literal, "me" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: As the Psalms terms note sets. Sheol is the world of the dead, not a place of punishment, so "l’enfer" would mislead. Nefesh is "âme" at Literal; the other levels say "me", the person himself, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Kuzimu" for Sheol at every level, through these psalms; Readable adds "mahali pa wafu" (the place of the dead)
decisions.reason: "Kuzimu" is the Swahili word for the world of the dead, so it serves every level. "Kaburi" names a single grave and is kept for the Hebrew "pit" at Readable, as the English Readable says "the grave".

decisions.choice: el Seol (L); el lugar de los muertos (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew name Sheol as "el Seol"; Balanced and Readable say what it is, the world of the dead. "Infierno" would suggest a place of punishment, which the word does not mean here.

decisions.choice: "Âm Phủ" (L, B); "nơi của người chết" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the published Psalm 139:8: Sheol, the world of the dead (see the meaning decision), is "Âm Phủ" written as a name; Readable says plainly "the place of the dead".

decisions.choice: Sheol is "스올" (L, B) and "죽은 사람들이 있는 곳" (R); nefesh is "영혼" at L, "저" (me) at B
decisions.reason: As the published Psalm 139:8 and the Psalms terms note: the Hebrew name of the world of the dead (meaning decision m2) is kept at Literal and Balanced and explained at Readable. "저승" brings in folk ideas of the afterlife. The pit stays "구덩이" (L, B) and "무덤" (R).

source.text: זַמְּר֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חֲסִידָ֑יו וְ֝הוֹד֗וּ לְזֵ֣כֶר קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Sing praises to YHWH, his faithful ones, and give thanks to [the] remembrance of his holiness.

en.L: Sing praises to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, you {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful ones, and give thanks to the remembrance of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holiness.
en.B: Make music to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all you who are loyal to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; give thanks as you call to mind {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy name.
en.R: All you people who are faithful to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, sing praises to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}! Thank {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and remember that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is holy.

fr.L: Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, vous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} fidèles, et rendez grâce au souvenir de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainteté.
fr.B: Faites de la musique pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, vous tous qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} êtes fidèles ; rendez grâce en rappelant {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} saint nom.
fr.R: Vous tous qui êtes fidèles {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, chantez pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ! Remerciez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}, et souvenez-vous qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est saint.

sw.L: Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} zaburi, enyi waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, mkashukuru ukumbusho wa utakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Mpigieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} muziki, ninyi nyote mlio waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}; shukuruni mnapolikumbuka jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu.
sw.R: Enyi watu wote mlio waaminifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mwimbieni sifa! Mshukuruni, na mkumbuke kwamba {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni mtakatifu.

es.L: {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} alabanzas {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} fieles, y {{plural_you:den|dad}} gracias al recuerdo de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santidad.
es.B: {{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} música para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, todos los que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} son leales; {{plural_you:den|dad}} gracias al traer a la memoria {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo nombre.
es.R: Todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que {{plural_you:son|sois}} fieles {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, ¡{{plural_you:cántenle|cantadle}} alabanzas! {{plural_you:Denle|Dadle}} gracias, y {{plural_you:recuerden|recordad}} que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es santo.

vi.L: Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi những người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và hãy cảm tạ khi nhớ đến sự thánh khiết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Hỡi tất cả những ai trung tín với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hãy đàn hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; hãy cảm tạ khi nhớ đến danh thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Hỡi tất cả những người trung tín với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hãy hát ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! Hãy cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và hãy nhớ rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là thánh.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 찬송하여라, 그분의 신실한 자들아. 그분의 거룩하심을 기억하며 감사하여라.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하여라, 그분께 충성하는 모든 이들아. 그분의 거룩한 이름을 떠올리며 감사하여라.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 신실한 모든 사람들아, 그분께 찬송을 불러라! 그분께 감사하고, 그분께서 거룩하신 분임을 기억하여라.

decisions.choice: his faithful ones: those who keep faith with God
decisions.reason: The word (chasid) is one who is loyal, as in 4:4 and 12:2.

decisions.choice: remembrance: the name by which God is remembered
decisions.reason: The word (zeker) is a memorial or name: "this is my remembrance for all generations" (Exodus 3:15; Psalm 97:12).

decisions.choice: his holy name
decisions.reason: Balanced says what the remembrance is (m2).

source.text: כִּ֤י רֶ֨גַע׀בְּאַפּוֹ֮ חַיִּ֪ים בִּרְצ֫וֹנ֥וֹ בָּ֭עֶרֶב יָלִ֥ין בֶּ֗כִי וְלַבֹּ֥קֶר רִנָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For a moment [is] in his anger, life [is] in his favor; in the evening weeping lodges, and to the morning [is] a shout of joy.

en.L: For a moment [is] in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger, life [is] in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} favor; in the evening weeping may lodge, but in the morning [comes] a shout of joy.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger is over in a moment, but in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} favor there is life; weeping may come to spend the night, but at dawn there are shouts of joy.
en.R: His anger lasts only a moment, but {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} kindness gives life. I may cry all night, but in the morning I will shout for joy.

fr.L: Car un instant [est] dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère, la vie [est] dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} faveur ; le soir les pleurs peuvent loger, mais au matin [vient] un cri de joie.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère ne dure qu’un instant, mais {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} faveur donne la vie ; les pleurs viennent parfois passer la nuit, mais à l’aube il y a des cris de joie.
fr.R: Sa colère dure seulement un instant, mais {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} bonté donne la vie. Je peux pleurer toute la nuit, mais au matin je crierai de joie.

sw.L: Kwa maana kitambo [kiko] katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, uhai [uko] katika radhi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; jioni kilio kinaweza kulala, lakini asubuhi [huja] kelele za furaha.
sw.B: Kwa maana hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} hupita kwa kitambo tu, lakini katika radhi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} mna uhai; kilio kinaweza kuja kulala usiku, lakini alfajiri kuna kelele za furaha.
sw.R: Hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} hudumu kwa kitambo tu, lakini wema {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} huleta uhai. Huenda nikalia usiku kucha, lakini asubuhi nitapiga kelele kwa furaha.

es.L: Porque un momento [dura] {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira, vida [hay] en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} favor; por la noche puede alojarse el llanto, pero por la mañana [viene] un grito de alegría.
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} enojo pasa en un momento, pero en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} favor hay vida; el llanto puede venir a pasar la noche, pero al amanecer hay gritos de alegría.
es.R: Su enojo dura solo un momento, pero {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} bondad da vida. Puede que llore toda la noche, pero por la mañana gritaré de alegría.

vi.L: Vì trong cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [chỉ có] một lúc, trong ân huệ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [có] sự sống; buổi tối sự khóc lóc có thể ở lại qua đêm, nhưng buổi sáng [đến] tiếng reo mừng.
vi.B: Vì cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chỉ trong giây lát, nhưng trong ân huệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có sự sống; tiếng khóc có thể đến ở lại ban đêm, nhưng lúc rạng đông có tiếng reo vui.
vi.R: Ngài chỉ giận trong giây lát, nhưng lòng tốt của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban sự sống. Tôi có thể khóc suốt đêm, nhưng buổi sáng tôi sẽ reo mừng.

ko.L: 참으로 그분의 진노는 잠깐이요, 그분의 은총에는 생명이 [있다]. 저녁에는 울음이 머물러도, 아침에는 기쁨의 환호가 [온다].
ko.B: 그분의 노여움은 잠깐 사이에 지나가지만, 그분의 은총 안에는 생명이 있다. 밤에는 울음이 찾아와 머물지라도, 새벽에는 기쁨의 환성이 있다.
ko.R: 그분의 노여움은 잠깐뿐이지만, 그분의 은혜는 생명을 준다. 나는 밤새 울지라도, 아침에는 기뻐 소리칠 것이다.

decisions.choice: life: life itself, or a whole lifetime
decisions.reason: The word (chayyim) is life; set against "a moment" it may mean a lifetime: his anger lasts a moment, his favor a lifetime.

decisions.choice: weeping lodges: sorrow stays only the night
decisions.reason: The verb (lin) is to stay overnight as a guest; weeping is a guest who leaves in the morning.

decisions.choice: I may cry all night
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m2).

records.literal_gloss: And I, I said in my ease, I will not be shaken forever.

en.L: As for me, I said in my ease, "I will never be shaken."
en.B: When things were going well for me, I said, "Nothing will ever shake me."
en.R: When my life was easy, I said to myself, "Nothing bad will ever happen to me."

fr.L: Quant à moi, j’ai dit dans ma tranquillité : « Je ne serai jamais ébranlé. »
fr.B: Quand tout allait bien pour moi, je disais : « Rien ne m’ébranlera jamais. »
fr.R: Quand ma vie était facile, je me disais : « Il ne m’arrivera jamais rien de mal. »

sw.L: Na mimi, nilisema katika raha yangu, "Sitatikiswa kamwe."
sw.B: Mambo yaliponiendea vizuri, nilisema, "Hakuna kitakachonitikisa kamwe."
sw.R: Maisha yangu yalipokuwa rahisi, nilijiambia, "Hakuna jambo baya litakalonipata kamwe."

es.L: En cuanto a mí, dije en mi tranquilidad: «Nunca seré sacudido».
es.B: Cuando todo me iba bien, dije: «Nada me hará tambalear jamás».
es.R: Cuando mi vida era fácil, me dije a mí mismo: «Nunca me pasará nada malo».

vi.L: Còn tôi, trong lúc yên ổn tôi đã nói: "Tôi sẽ không bao giờ bị lay chuyển."
vi.B: Khi mọi sự đang suôn sẻ, tôi đã nói: "Chẳng gì có thể lay chuyển tôi được."
vi.R: Khi đời tôi dễ dàng, tôi tự nhủ: "Sẽ chẳng bao giờ có điều gì xấu xảy đến cho tôi."

ko.L: 저로 말하자면, 제가 평안할 때에 말하였습니다. "나는 영원히 흔들리지 않을 것이다."
ko.B: 일이 잘 풀릴 때 저는 말하였습니다. "무엇도 나를 흔들지 못할 것이다."
ko.R: 제 삶이 편안할 때 저는 속으로 말하였습니다. "나에게는 절대로 나쁜 일이 일어나지 않을 거야."

decisions.choice: my ease: carefree security
decisions.reason: The word (shelev) is ease and quiet, the feeling that all is well; it can slide into careless self-confidence.

decisions.choice: I will never be shaken: the boast of the wicked
decisions.reason: The wicked says the same words in 10:6. The psalmist confesses that he spoke as if his security were his own.

source.text: יְֽהוָ֗ה בִּרְצוֹנְךָ֮ הֶעֱמַ֪דְתָּה לְֽהַרְרִ֫י עֹ֥ז הִסְתַּ֥רְתָּ פָנֶ֗יךָ הָיִ֥יתִי נִבְהָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH, by your favor you made stand for my mountain strength; you hid your face; I was terrified.

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, by {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} favor {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made my mountain stand strong; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} hid {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face; I was terrified.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} kindness {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} had made me firm as a mountain; then {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} hid {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face, and I was overcome with fear.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} were kind to me, I felt as strong as a mountain. But when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} turned away from me, I was terrified.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, par {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} faveur {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} avais fait tenir ma montagne forte ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as caché {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face ; j’ai été épouvanté.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bonté {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’avais rendu solide comme une montagne ; puis {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as caché {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face, et la peur m’a saisi.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} étais bon pour moi, je me sentais fort comme une montagne. Mais quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}es détourné de moi, j’ai été terrifié.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa radhi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} uliufanya mlima wangu usimame imara; ulificha uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; nikafadhaika sana.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa wema {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ulikuwa umenifanya imara kama mlima; kisha ukaficha uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, nami nikajawa na hofu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ulipokuwa mwema kwangu, nilijiona kuwa na nguvu kama mlima. Lakini ulipogeuka mbali nami, niliogopa sana.

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} favor {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} hiciste que mi monte se mantuviera fuerte; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} escondiste {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro; quedé aterrado.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} bondad {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me habías hecho firme como un monte; luego {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} escondiste {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro, y el miedo me dominó.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, cuando {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eras bueno conmigo, me sentía fuerte como una montaña. Pero cuando {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} te apartaste de mí, me llené de terror.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, bởi ân huệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho núi của tôi đứng vững mạnh; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ẩn mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; tôi đã kinh hoàng.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, trong lòng nhân từ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho tôi vững như núi; rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ẩn mặt đi, và tôi bị nỗi sợ hãi bao trùm.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tử tế với tôi, tôi thấy mình vững mạnh như núi. Nhưng khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quay mặt đi khỏi tôi, tôi kinh hoàng.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 은총으로 주님께서 제 산을 굳게 세우셨으나, 주님께서 주님의 얼굴을 숨기시니, 저는 두려움에 떨었습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 은혜를 베푸셔서 저를 산처럼 굳게 세우셨는데, 주님께서 얼굴을 숨기시자 저는 두려움에 사로잡혔습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 저에게 은혜를 베푸실 때 저는 산처럼 강하다고 느꼈습니다. 그러나 주님께서 저에게서 얼굴을 돌리시자 저는 몹시 두려웠습니다.

decisions.choice: made my mountain stand strong: made me secure
alternatives: you set me on a strong mountain
you made my royal mountain (Zion) firm
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is hard to construe: "you made stand for my mountain strength". It may mean that God made the psalmist as secure as a mountain, or that he set him on a strong mountain; some take "my mountain" as Zion, the king's stronghold.

decisions.choice: you hid your face: you withdrew your favor
decisions.reason: As in 27:9; it is the opposite of God's favor in the first line.

decisions.choice: firm as a mountain (B); as strong as a mountain (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable follow the first sense in m1.

records.literal_gloss: To you, YHWH, I called, and to [the] Lord I pleaded for favor.

en.L: To {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I called, and to the Lord I pleaded for mercy.
en.B: I called out to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}; I begged the Lord for mercy.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I called to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. I begged the Lord to show me mercy.

fr.L: Vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’ai appelé, et le Seigneur, je l’ai supplié de me faire grâce.
fr.B: J’ai crié vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; j’ai supplié le Seigneur d’avoir pitié.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ai appelé. J’ai supplié le Seigneur d’avoir pitié de moi.

sw.L: Kwako, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, niliita, na kwa Bwana niliomba rehema.

es.L: A {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, clamé, y al Señor supliqué misericordia.
es.B: Clamé a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; le rogué al Señor que tuviera misericordia.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} llamé. Le rogué al Señor que me mostrara misericordia.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi đã kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và với Chúa tôi đã nài xin ơn thương xót.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi đã kêu lên cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; tôi đã nài xin Chúa thương xót.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi đã kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Tôi đã nài xin Chúa thương xót tôi.

ko.L: 주님께, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 부르짖었고, 주님께 은총을 간구하였습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 주님께 부르짖었고, 주님께 자비를 구하였습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 주님을 불렀습니다. 저에게 자비를 베풀어 달라고 주님께 빌었습니다.

decisions.choice: the Lord: God as master
decisions.reason: The word ('Adonai) is a title, "my Lord", used for God alone.

decisions.choice: I called: the psalmist tells what he prayed
decisions.reason: The verb forms tell of the past. Verses 10-11 give the words of his prayer.

decisions.choice: "Chúa" for Adonai, beside "CHÚA" for the name
decisions.reason: The style guide renders Adonai, God as master (see the meaning decision), as "Chúa" in ordinary letters, so readers can tell it from the divine name written "CHÚA".

decisions.choice: Adonai ("the Lord") is "주님", the same word as the address to God
decisions.reason: The style guide (section 7a) gives "주님" for Adonai. Here it also matches the title by which the singer addresses God, so Korean reads the second line as speaking of the same Lord, as the Hebrew does.

source.text: מַה־בֶּ֥צַע בְּדָמִי֮ בְּרִדְתִּ֪י אֶ֫ל־שָׁ֥חַת הֲיוֹדְךָ֥ עָפָ֑ר הֲיַגִּ֥יד אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: What profit [is] in my blood, in my going down to [the] pit? Will dust thank you? Will it declare your faithfulness?

en.L: "What profit [is there] in my blood, in my going down to [the] pit? Will [the] dust give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}? Will it declare {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness?
en.B: "What would anyone gain from my death, from my going down into the pit? Can dust give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}? Can it speak of how faithful {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are?
en.R: "What good would it do if I died and went down into the grave? Dead people cannot thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. Their dust cannot tell others that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are faithful.

fr.L: « Quel profit [y a-t-il] dans mon sang, dans ma descente vers [la] fosse ? [La] poussière {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendra-t-elle grâce ? Annoncera-t-elle {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fidélité ?
fr.B: « Que gagnerait-on à ma mort, à ma descente dans la fosse ? La poussière peut-elle {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendre grâce ? Peut-elle dire combien {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es fidèle ?
fr.R: « À quoi cela servirait-il que je meure et que je descende dans la tombe ? Les morts ne peuvent pas {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercier. Leur poussière ne peut pas dire aux autres que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es fidèle.

sw.L: "Kuna faida gani katika damu yangu, katika kushuka kwangu shimoni? Je, mavumbi yatakushukuru? Je, yatatangaza uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}?
sw.B: "Mtu angepata nini kwa kifo changu, kwa kushuka kwangu shimoni? Je, mavumbi yanaweza kukushukuru? Je, yanaweza kusimulia jinsi ulivyo mwaminifu?
sw.R: "Kungekuwa na faida gani kama ningekufa na kushuka kaburini? Wafu hawawezi kukushukuru. Mavumbi yao hayawezi kuwaambia wengine kwamba {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni mwaminifu.

es.L: «¿Qué provecho [hay] en mi sangre, en que yo descienda a [la] fosa? ¿Te dará gracias [el] polvo? ¿Anunciará {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fidelidad?
es.B: «¿Qué ganaría alguien con mi muerte, con que yo baje a la fosa? ¿Puede el polvo darte gracias? ¿Puede contar lo fiel que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres?
es.R: «¿De qué serviría que yo muriera y bajara a la tumba? Los muertos no pueden darte gracias. Su polvo no puede contar a otros que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres fiel.

vi.L: "Có ích lợi gì trong máu tôi, trong việc tôi đi xuống huyệt? Bụi đất sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sao? Nó sẽ rao truyền sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sao?
vi.B: "Ai được lợi gì khi tôi chết, khi tôi đi xuống huyệt sâu? Bụi đất có thể cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được sao? Nó có thể nói về sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được sao?
vi.R: "Nếu tôi chết và đi xuống mồ thì có ích lợi gì? Người chết không thể cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Bụi đất của họ không thể nói cho người khác biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thành tín.

ko.L: "제 피에, 제가 구덩이로 내려가는 데에 무슨 유익이 [있겠습니까]? 티끌이 주님께 감사하겠습니까? 그것이 주님의 신실하심을 전하겠습니까?
ko.B: "제가 죽어 구덩이로 내려간들 누구에게 무슨 이득이 있겠습니까? 티끌이 주님께 감사할 수 있겠습니까? 티끌이 주님의 신실하심을 전할 수 있겠습니까?
ko.R: "제가 죽어서 무덤으로 내려가면 무슨 좋은 일이 있겠습니까? 죽은 사람은 주님께 감사할 수 없습니다. 그들의 흙먼지는 주님께서 신실하시다고 다른 사람들에게 알릴 수 없습니다.

decisions.choice: my blood: my death
decisions.reason: Blood stands for life poured out in death.

decisions.choice: Will dust thank you?: the dead cannot praise
decisions.reason: The dead return to dust (Genesis 3:19). The psalms argue that if God lets his servant die, there will be one voice fewer to praise him (6:6; 88:11-13; Isaiah 38:18).

decisions.choice: the words of his prayer
decisions.reason: Verses 10-11 quote what the psalmist said when he called out (verse 9).

decisions.choice: Dead people cannot thank you
decisions.reason: Readable turns the questions into what they mean (m2).

records.literal_gloss: Hear, YHWH, and be gracious to me; YHWH, be a helper to me.

en.L: Hear, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and be gracious to me; {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, be a helper to me."
en.B: Listen, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and show me grace; {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, come and help me."
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, listen to me and be kind to me. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, help me!"

fr.L: Écoute, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et fais-moi grâce ; {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, sois pour moi un secours. »
fr.B: Écoute, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et montre-moi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} grâce ; {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, viens à mon aide. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, écoute-moi et sois bon pour moi. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, aide-moi ! »

sw.L: Usikie, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na unifanyie neema; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uwe msaidizi wangu."
sw.B: Usikilize, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na unionyeshe neema; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, njoo unisaidie."

es.L: Oye, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y ten piedad de mí; {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, sé mi ayudador».
es.B: Escucha, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y ten compasión de mí; {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ven a ayudarme».

vi.L: Xin nghe, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và thương xót tôi; lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin làm Đấng giúp đỡ tôi."
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin lắng nghe và tỏ ân huệ cho tôi; lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin đến giúp tôi."
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin nghe tôi và thương xót tôi. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin giúp tôi!"

ko.L: 들으십시오, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저에게 은혜를 베푸십시오. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 돕는 이가 되어 주십시오."
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 들어 주시고 은혜를 베풀어 주십시오. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 오셔서 저를 도와주십시오."
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제 말을 들으시고 저를 불쌍히 여겨 주십시오. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 도와주십시오!"

decisions.choice: a helper: one who comes to the rescue
decisions.reason: The word ('ozer) is one who comes to help in need, used often of God (10:14; 54:6).

source.text: הָפַ֣כְתָּ מִסְפְּדִי֮ לְמָח֪וֹל לִ֥י פִּתַּ֥חְתָּ שַׂקִּ֑י וַֽתְּאַזְּרֵ֥נִי שִׂמְחָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: You turned my wailing into dancing for me; you loosed my sackcloth and girded me [with] joy,

en.L: You have changed my wailing into dancing for me; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have untied my sackcloth and wrapped me [with] joy,
en.B: You have changed my lament into dancing; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} took off my sackcloth and dressed me in joy,
en.R: You changed my crying into dancing. You took away my clothes of sadness and gave me joy to wear instead.

fr.L: Tu as changé pour moi ma lamentation en danse ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as dénoué mon sac et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as ceint [de] joie,
fr.B: Tu as changé ma plainte en danse ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as ôté mon sac et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as revêtu de joie,
fr.R: Tu as changé mes pleurs en danse. Tu m’as enlevé mes vêtements de tristesse, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as donné la joie à porter à la place.

sw.L: Umegeuza maombolezo yangu kuwa kucheza kwa ajili yangu; umefungua gunia langu na kunifunga furaha [kiunoni],
sw.B: Umegeuza kilio changu kuwa ngoma; ulinivua gunia langu na kunivika furaha,
sw.R: Uligeuza kilio changu kuwa ngoma. Uliniondolea nguo zangu za huzuni na kunipa furaha nivae badala yake.

es.L: Tú has cambiado mi lamento en danza para mí; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has desatado mi tela de saco y me has ceñido [de] alegría,
es.B: Tú has convertido mi lamento en danza; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me quitaste la ropa de luto y me vestiste de alegría,
es.R: Cambiaste mi llanto en baile. Me quitaste la ropa de tristeza y en su lugar me vestiste de alegría.

vi.L: {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đổi tiếng than khóc của tôi thành điệu nhảy múa cho tôi; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cởi áo vải thô của tôi và thắt lưng tôi [bằng] niềm vui,
vi.B: {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đổi tiếng than van của tôi thành điệu múa; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cởi bỏ áo vải thô của tôi và mặc cho tôi niềm vui,
vi.R: Ngài đã đổi tiếng khóc của tôi thành điệu múa. Ngài đã cởi bỏ bộ áo buồn rầu của tôi và cho tôi mặc niềm vui thay vào.

ko.L: 주님께서 저를 위하여 제 통곡을 춤으로 바꾸셨고, 제 굵은 베옷을 푸시고 기쁨으로 저를 띠 두르셨으니,
ko.B: 주님께서 제 슬픔의 노래를 춤으로 바꾸셨고, 제 굵은 베옷을 벗기시고 기쁨으로 저를 입히셨으니,
ko.R: 주님께서 제 울음을 춤으로 바꾸셨습니다. 제 슬픔의 옷을 벗기시고 기쁨을 대신 입혀 주셨습니다.

decisions.choice: sackcloth: the rough clothing of mourning
decisions.reason: Mourners wore sackcloth, a coarse cloth of goat hair (Genesis 37:34); to take it off was to put mourning behind.

decisions.choice: wailing: loud lament, as for the dead
decisions.reason: The word (misped) is the lament made at a funeral.

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: The sentence continues into verse 13 ("so that ..."), so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: my clothes of sadness
decisions.reason: Readable says what sackcloth stood for (m1).

source.text: לְמַ֤עַן׀יְזַמֶּרְךָ֣ כָ֭בוֹד וְלֹ֣א יִדֹּ֑ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י לְעוֹלָ֥ם אוֹדֶֽךָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: so that glory may sing praise to you and not be silent; YHWH my God, forever I will give thanks to you.

en.L: so that [my] glory may sing praise to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and not be silent; {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, forever I will give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: so that with all that is in me I may make music to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and not keep quiet. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, I will give {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} thanks for all time.
en.R: Now I can sing praises to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} with all my heart and never stop. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, I will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} forever.

fr.L: afin que [ma] gloire {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} chante et ne se taise pas ; {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, pour toujours je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendrai grâce.
fr.B: afin que de tout mon être je joue pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} et ne garde pas le silence. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendrai grâce à jamais.
fr.R: Maintenant je peux chanter pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} de tout mon cœur, sans jamais m’arrêter. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercierai toujours.

sw.L: ili utukufu [wangu] ukuimbie zaburi wala usinyamaze; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, milele nitakushukuru.
sw.B: ili kwa vyote vilivyomo ndani yangu nikupigie muziki, wala nisinyamaze. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, nitakushukuru siku zote.
sw.R: Sasa ninaweza kukuimbia sifa kwa moyo wangu wote bila kuacha. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, nitakushukuru milele.

es.L: para que [mi] gloria {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cante alabanzas y no calle; {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío, para siempre {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daré gracias.
es.B: para que con todo mi ser {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cante y no me quede callado. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios mío, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daré gracias por todos los tiempos.
es.R: Ahora puedo cantarte alabanzas con todo mi corazón, sin parar nunca. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios mío, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daré gracias para siempre.

vi.L: để vinh quang [của tôi] hát ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và không im lặng; lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, tôi sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến đời đời.
vi.B: để với cả con người mình, tôi đàn hát cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và không im lặng. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, tôi sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mãi mãi.
vi.R: Giờ đây tôi có thể hết lòng hát ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và không bao giờ ngừng. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, tôi sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến đời đời.

ko.L: [제] 영광이 주님께 찬송하고 잠잠하지 않게 하시려는 것입니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 저의 하나님, 제가 영원히 주님께 감사하겠습니다.
ko.B: 제 온 존재가 주님께 노래하며 잠잠하지 않게 하시려는 것입니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 저의 하나님, 제가 영원토록 주님께 감사드리겠습니다.
ko.R: 이제 저는 온 마음으로 주님께 찬송하며 멈추지 않겠습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 저의 하나님, 제가 영원히 주님께 감사하겠습니다.

decisions.choice: glory: my inner self, my whole being
decisions.reason: The word (kavod) is "glory"; in a few psalms it stands for the inner self, the seat of feeling (16:9; 57:9). Some read it with different vowels as "my liver", a word for the inner being.

decisions.choice: not be silent: the answer to verse 10
decisions.reason: The dead cannot praise (verse 10); the one God has brought back cannot keep quiet.

decisions.choice: with all that is in me (B); with all my heart (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the word means here (m1).
